content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: XQL(AWS IAM Enumeration Sequence) AND XQL(AWS S3 Buckets Enumeration Activity) observed for the same userIdentity.arn within a 15-minute window, stitched into one cloud-reconnaissance-sequence incident anchored to the caller-ARN causality chain.
rules.name: Cloud Reconnaissance Sequence — IAM Then S3 Enumeration by One Principal
